candidates.statement: The amended performance standard for sunlamp products (21 CFR 1040.20) was published in the September 6, 1985, issue of the Federal Register and will become effective September 8, 1986. Any ultraviolet lamp (intended to be used in sunlamp products) and sunlamp products manufacturedeon or after that date must comply with the amended standard.
